description: EXP-024: Semantic Discrimination x Decoding - pares minimos balanceados
design: Mismo evidence, claims que difieren en un elemento semantico. Mide si P(TRUE)/P(FALSE) cambia.

groups.description: Entailment minimal pairs: mismo evidence, claim soportado vs no-soportado

pairs.evidence: The system supports encryption at rest and encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_a: The system supports encryption at rest.
pairs.claim_b: The system supports encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_c: The system supports access logging.
pairs.rationale: A y B estan soportados, C no esta mencionado. Si BitNet discrimina, P(TRUE|A) y P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: The framework consists of five functions: Identify, Detect, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
pairs.claim_a: The framework has five functions.
pairs.claim_b: The framework has six functions.
pairs.claim_c: The framework requires multi-factor authentication.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B contradice (cinco vs seis), C no mencionado. P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B) y P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: The protocol requires authentication for all administrative endpoints.
pairs.claim_a: The protocol requires authentication for administrative endpoints.
pairs.claim_b: The protocol requires authentication for all endpoints.
pairs.claim_c: The protocol does not require authentication for administrative endpoints.
pairs.rationale: A soportado (paraphrase), B over-specificity (all vs administrative), C contradiccion directa. P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: Product X supports AES-256 encryption for data at rest.
pairs.claim_a: Product X supports AES-256 encryption for data at rest.
pairs.claim_b: Product Y supports AES-256 encryption for data at rest.
pairs.claim_c: Product X supports AES-128 encryption for data at rest.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B wrong subject (Product Y), C contradiccion (AES-256 vs AES-128). P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B) y P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: The standard recommends regular risk assessments but does not mandate a specific frequency.
pairs.claim_a: The standard recommends regular risk assessments.
pairs.claim_b: The standard mandates quarterly risk assessments.
pairs.claim_c: The standard requires multi-factor authentication.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B contradice (recommends vs mandates, specific frequency), C no mencionado.

groups.description: Contradiction minimal pairs: negacion explicita vs implicita

pairs.evidence: The system does not support encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_a: The system supports encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_b: The system does not support encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_c: The system supports encryption at rest.
pairs.rationale: A contradice (negacion en evidence), B coincide con negacion, C no mencionado. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

pairs.evidence: The protocol does not require authentication for public endpoints.
pairs.claim_a: The protocol requires authentication for public endpoints.
pairs.claim_b: The protocol does not require authentication for public endpoints.
pairs.claim_c: The protocol requires authentication for all endpoints.
pairs.rationale: A contradice, B coincide, C over-generaliza. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

pairs.evidence: The framework includes five functions, not six.
pairs.claim_a: The framework includes six functions.
pairs.claim_b: The framework includes five functions.
pairs.claim_c: The framework includes seven functions.
pairs.rationale: A y C contradicen, B soportado. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A) y P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: Product X uses AES-256, not AES-128, for encryption at rest.
pairs.claim_a: Product X uses AES-128 for encryption at rest.
pairs.claim_b: Product X uses AES-256 for encryption at rest.
pairs.claim_c: Product X uses ChaCha20 for encryption at rest.
pairs.rationale: A y C contradicen (algoritmo incorrecto), B soportado. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

pairs.evidence: The standard applies to federal agencies, not to state or local governments.
pairs.claim_a: The standard applies to state governments.
pairs.claim_b: The standard applies to federal agencies.
pairs.claim_c: The standard applies to all government agencies.
pairs.rationale: A contradice (excluye state), B soportado, C over-generaliza. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

groups.description: Absence minimal pairs: claim con componente adicional ausente

pairs.evidence: The system supports encryption at rest and encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_a: The system supports encryption at rest, encryption in transit, and access logging.
pairs.claim_b: The system supports encryption at rest and encryption in transit.
pairs.claim_c: The system supports encryption at rest, encryption in transit, access logging, and quantum key distribution.
pairs.rationale: B soportado, A y C tienen componente ausente (access logging, QKD). Si BitNet detecta ausencia: P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: The framework provides risk assessment and mitigation guidance.
pairs.claim_a: The framework provides risk assessment, mitigation, and recovery guidance.
pairs.claim_b: The framework provides risk assessment and mitigation guidance.
pairs.claim_c: The framework provides risk assessment, mitigation, recovery, and compliance guidance.
pairs.rationale: B soportado, A y C tienen componentes ausentes. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

pairs.evidence: The protocol supports TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.
pairs.claim_a: The protocol supports TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3, and TLS 1.1.
pairs.claim_b: The protocol supports TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.
pairs.claim_c: The protocol supports TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3, TLS 1.1, and TLS 1.0.
pairs.rationale: B soportado, A y C agregan versiones no mencionadas. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

pairs.evidence: The system implements role-based access control and audit logging.
pairs.claim_a: The system implements role-based access control, audit logging, and intrusion detection.
pairs.claim_b: The system implements role-based access control and audit logging.
pairs.claim_c: The system implements role-based access control.
pairs.rationale: B y C soportados (C es subset), A tiene componente ausente. P(TRUE|B) >= P(TRUE|C) > P(TRUE|A).

pairs.evidence: The product is certified for FIPS 140-2 Level 2.
pairs.claim_a: The product is certified for FIPS 140-2 Level 2 and Level 3.
pairs.claim_b: The product is certified for FIPS 140-2 Level 2.
pairs.claim_c: The product is certified for FIPS 140-2 Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4.
pairs.rationale: B soportado, A y C agregan niveles no mencionados. P(TRUE|B) > P(TRUE|A).

groups.description: Subject/context minimal pairs: mismo topico, diferente entidad

pairs.evidence: Product X supports encryption at rest and in transit.
pairs.claim_a: Product X supports encryption at rest.
pairs.claim_b: Product Y supports encryption at rest.
pairs.claim_c: Product Z supports encryption at rest.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B y C son wrong subject. Si BitNet discrimina subject: P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B) y P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|C).

pairs.evidence: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework provides guidance for managing cybersecurity risk.
pairs.claim_a: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework provides guidance for managing cybersecurity risk.
pairs.claim_b: The ISO 27001 standard provides guidance for managing cybersecurity risk.
pairs.claim_c: The CIS Controls provide guidance for managing cybersecurity risk.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B y C son wrong subject (ISO/CIS vs NIST). P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B).

pairs.evidence: The TLS 1.3 protocol supports forward secrecy by default.
pairs.claim_a: The TLS 1.3 protocol supports forward secrecy by default.
pairs.claim_b: The TLS 1.2 protocol supports forward secrecy by default.
pairs.claim_c: The SSL 3.0 protocol supports forward secrecy by default.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B y C son wrong subject (TLS 1.2/SSL 3.0 vs TLS 1.3). P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B).

pairs.evidence: AWS S3 provides server-side encryption with S3-managed keys.
pairs.claim_a: AWS S3 provides server-side encryption with S3-managed keys.
pairs.claim_b: Azure Blob Storage provides server-side encryption with S3-managed keys.
pairs.claim_c: Google Cloud Storage provides server-side encryption with S3-managed keys.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B y C son wrong subject (Azure/GCS vs AWS S3). P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B).

pairs.evidence: The federal standard requires annual security assessments for classified systems.
pairs.claim_a: The federal standard requires annual security assessments for classified systems.
pairs.claim_b: The federal standard requires annual security assessments for unclassified systems.
pairs.claim_c: The state standard requires annual security assessments for classified systems.
pairs.rationale: A soportado, B wrong context (unclassified vs classified), C wrong subject (state vs federal). P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|B) y P(TRUE|A) > P(TRUE|C).
